# 1. Metadata Table

```{r}
mt <- data.table::fread(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "raw_data", "MetadataforAnalyses_TransMicro123.csv"), sep=";",header=TRUE)

mt <- mt %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(ID_pool = dplyr::case_when(Run == 1 ~ paste0(ID_pool, "_rn1"), Run == 2 ~ paste0(ID_pool, "_rn2"), Run == 3 ~ paste0(ID_pool, "_rn3"), TRUE ~ ID_pool))

mt <- mt %>%
  dplyr::mutate(LifeStage = ifelse(ID_pool == "MS_066_rn2", "na", LifeStage),
    Transmission = ifelse(ID_pool == "MS_066_rn2", "Fruits_5_6days", Transmission))

# f -> F 
mt <- mt %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Sample_Category = ifelse(Sample_Category == "All_stages_focal_Sites", "All_stages_Focal_Sites", Sample_Category))

# Export
write.table(mt, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "1_PrepareData", "TransMicro123_metadata.tsv"), sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE, quote=FALSE)

## Precision of the nb of samples
mt_samples <- mt %>%
  dplyr::group_by(FrozenLifeStage, SampleType, N, Substrate, Pop, FruitSite, FruitSiteTypeVariety, DevFruit) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(SampleCount = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")

write.csv(mt_samples, file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "1_PrepareData", "TM123_metadata_samples_data.csv"), row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
```

# 2. Bacterial community

## 2.1. Abundance table

### Import & Clean Multi-Affiliation Table
```{r}
ma_16S <- data.table::fread(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "raw_data", "16S_TM123-[FROGS_BIOM_to_TSV__multi-affiliations.tsv].tsv"),sep="\t",header=TRUE)
dim(ma_16S)# 181 347 lignes

# Clean taxonomy of multi-affiliation table 
taxo_16S_Multiaffiliation <- Define_multiaffiliation(multiaffiliation_table = ma_16S, thresh = 0.5) # filter the tax names with freq inf to 0,5 (within cluster) and assign a tax name (if 1 valid name) or multi/unknown (if multiple valid names)
```

### Import & Clean Abundance Table
```{r}
ab_16S <- data.table::fread(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "raw_data", "16S_TM123-[FROGS_BIOM_to_TSV__abundance.tsv].tsv"),sep="\t",header=TRUE)
data.table::setnames(ab_16S, old = names(ab_16S), new = gsub("-", "_", names(ab_16S)))
dim(ab_16S)

# Correct errors on sample names
colnames(ab_16S)[colnames(ab_16S) == "16S_MS_0100_rn1_A"] <- "16S_MS_100_rn1_A"
colnames(ab_16S)[colnames(ab_16S) == "16S_MS_0125_rn1_A"] <- "16S_MS_125_rn1_A"
colnames(ab_16S)[colnames(ab_16S) == "16S_MS_0221_rn1_A"] <- "16S_MS_221_rn1_A"

# Clean taxonomy
ab_16S <- Clean_ab_table(abundance_table = ab_16S, remove_col = NULL) #Expected 7 pieces. Missing pieces filled with `NA` in 91 rows 
```

### Abundance table with multi-affiliation and chimeras removed
```{r}
# New version of ab_16s : taxonomy with multi-affiliation and chimeras removed
at_16S <- Combine_ab_multi_affi_tables_remove_chim(multi_affi_table = taxo_16S_Multiaffiliation, name = "TransMicro1-2-3_16S", abundance_table = ab_16S) # 2049 bimeras/6966 sequences, proportion = 0.29

dim(at_16S) # 4917 clusters

# Replaces the taxonomy not found with the taxonomy found manually in BLAST
at_16S_no <- subset(at_16S, grepl("no;NA;NA;NA;NA;NA;NA", blast_taxonomy))# blast_taxonomy = "no;NA;NA;NA;NA;NA;NA" 
at_16S_no$observation_name # 75 clusters

# blast_taxonomy : no;NA;NA;NA;NA;NA;NA : add the taxonomy obtained by BLAST with NCBI (see 16S_TransMicro_Cluster_Blast.xlsx)

at_16S[at_16S$observation_name == "Cluster_157", "seed_sequence"]

at_16S[at_16S$observation_name == "Cluster_162", "seed_sequence"]

at_16S$blast_taxonomy[which(at_16S$observation_name == "Cluster_218")] <- "Bacteria;Unknown;Unknown;Unknown;Unknown;Unknown;Unknown"

at_16S$blast_taxonomy[which(at_16S$observation_name == "Cluster_402")] <- "Fungi;Mucoromycota;Mucoromycetes;Mucorales;Mucorineae;Mucoraceae;Mucor;Unknown"

at_16S$blast_taxonomy[which(at_16S$observation_name == "Cluster_466")] <- "Bacteria;Unknown;Unknown;Unknown;Unknown;Unknown;Unknown"

at_16S$blast_taxonomy[which(at_16S$observation_name == "Cluster_553")] <- "Bacteria;Unknown;Unknown;Unknown;Unknown;Unknown;Unknown"

at_16S$blast_taxonomy[which(at_16S$observation_name == "Cluster_572")] <- "Fungi;Unknown;Unknown;Unknown;Unknown;Unknown;Unknown"

at_16S$blast_taxonomy[which(at_16S$observation_name == "Cluster_611")] <- "Bacteria;Unknown;Unknown;Unknown;Unknown;Unknown;Unknown"

at_16S$blast_taxonomy[which(at_16S$observation_name == "Cluster_698")] <- "Fungi;Ascomycota;Taphrinomycetes;Taphrinales;Taphrinaceae;Taphrina;Unkown"

at_16S[at_16S$observation_name == "Cluster_984", "seed_sequence"] #Unknown

# Rename the left clusters as "Unknown" (cluster nb sup. to 1000)
at_16S <- at_16S %>%
  dplyr::mutate(blast_taxonomy = ifelse(blast_taxonomy == "no;NA;NA;NA;NA;NA;NA", "Unknown;Unknown;Unknown;Unknown;Unknown;Unknown;Unknown", blast_taxonomy))

# Split taxonomy
at_16S <- at_16S %>% 
  tidyr::separate(col=blast_taxonomy, into=c("Kingdom","Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species"), sep=";", remove=FALSE)
```

### Compute coverage depth for each type of sample
```{r}
# Subset dataset (filter controls) and transpose it to have sample on rows
at_16S
abundance_table_16S <- at_16S %>%
  dplyr::select(matches("16S_MS|Kingdom|observation_name")) %>% 
  dplyr::rename_with( ~ gsub("16S_", "", .x, fixed = TRUE))%>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(!c(observation_name, Kingdom), names_to="ID_pool", values_to = "cov_depth")
abundance_table_16S

# Rename samples without replicate "A" and "B"
abundance_table_16S <- abundance_table_16S %>%
  dplyr::mutate(ID_pool=gsub("_A|_B", "", ID_pool))

# Add corresponding samples' info from metadata
abundance_table_16S <- abundance_table_16S  %>%
  dplyr::left_join(mt[, c("ID_pool", "FrozenLifeStage", "SampleType", "Infestation")], by= "ID_pool")

# Compute coverage depth for each sample type
sample.size_16S <- abundance_table_16S %>%
  dplyr::group_by(SampleType, Infestation, Kingdom) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n_distinct(ID_pool), cov_depth=sum(cov_depth))%>%
  dplyr::mutate(prop_cov_depth = round(cov_depth/sum(cov_depth), 2))
sample.size_16S

# Export
write.table(sample.size_16S, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "1_PrepareData", "16S_TM1-2-3_Coverage_depth_per_Sample_Type.csv"), sep=";", row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE, quote=FALSE)

#Plot
# Create a stacked bar plot of kingdom proportions by SampleType
prop_16S <- ggplot(sample.size_16S, aes(x = SampleType, y = prop_cov_depth, fill = Kingdom)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") + 
  labs(
    title = "Proportions of Kingdoms by Sample Type - 16S",
    x = "Sample Type",
    y = "Proportion of coverage depth"
  ) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Bacteria" = "blue3", "Fungi" = "green", "Plantae_Chl" = "green3", "Plantae_Mit" = "green4", "Unknown" = "grey", "no" = "grey")) +  # Example colors, adjust for your kingdoms
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"  )
prop_16S

title_plot <- "16S_TM123_CovDepth_Proportions.png"
 cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "1_PrepareData", title_plot),
                 prop_16S, base_height = 20/cm(1),
                base_width = 25/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
```

### Delete clusters with Multi-affiliation, Plantae, Fungi and Unknown in Kingdom taxonomic rank
```{r}
dim(at_16S) #4917 clusters
# blast_taxonomy : Unknown in Kingdom rank
at_16S_Unknown <- at_16S[at_16S$Kingdom == "Unknown",]
at_16S_Unknown$observation_name # 0 cluster 

# blast_taxonomy : Multi-affiliation in Kingdom rank
at_16S_Multiaffiliation <- at_16S[at_16S$Kingdom == "Multi-affiliation",]
at_16S_Multiaffiliation$observation_name # 1 cluster : 2629

# blast_taxonomy : Fungi in Kingdom rank
at_16S_Fungi <-  at_16S[at_16S$Kingdom == "Fungi",]
at_16S_Fungi$observation_name # 5 clusters

# blast_taxonomy : Plantae in Kingdom rank
at_16S_Plantae <-  at_16S[at_16S$Kingdom =="Plantae_Chl" |	at_16S$Kingdom =="Plantae_Mit",]
at_16S_Plantae$observation_name # 302 clusters 

# Delete these clusters
at_16S <- at_16S  %>%
  dplyr::slice(which(is.na(match(Kingdom, c("Plantae_Chl", "Plantae_Mit", "Fungi")))))# "Multi-affiliation", "Unknown"

dim(at_16S) #4610 clusters
```

### Replace "Multi-affiliation", "unidentified", "unknown species", "unknown genus", "unknown family", "unknown" by "Unknown" in the taxonomy
```{r}
replace_names <- c("Multi-affiliation", "unidentified", "unknown species", "unknown genus", "unknown family", "unknown")

at_16S <- at_16S %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Kingdom = ifelse(Kingdom %in% replace_names, "Unknown", Kingdom),
         Phylum = ifelse(Phylum %in% replace_names, "Unknown", Phylum),
         Class = ifelse(Class %in% replace_names, "Unknown", Class),
         Order = ifelse(Order %in% replace_names, "Unknown", Order),
         Family = ifelse(Family %in% replace_names, "Unknown", Family),
         Genus = ifelse(Genus %in% replace_names, "Unknown", Genus),
         Species = ifelse(Species %in% replace_names, "Unknown", Species))

# Create a Genus_2 column with the Genus and row number
at_16S$Genus2 <- paste0(at_16S$Genus, rownames(at_16S))
```

### Filter abundance table
```{r}
# Select columns
at_16S <- at_16S %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::starts_with("observation_name")|dplyr::starts_with("observation_sum")|dplyr::starts_with("seed_sequence")|dplyr::starts_with("Kingdom")|dplyr::starts_with("Phylum")|dplyr::starts_with("Class")|dplyr::starts_with("Order")|dplyr::starts_with("Family")|dplyr::starts_with("Genus")|dplyr::starts_with("Species")|dplyr::starts_with("16S_")|dplyr::starts_with("ITS_")|dplyr::starts_with("NC_")|dplyr::starts_with("Undetermined"))

# Controls data in a separate table
at_16S_Controls <- at_16S %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::starts_with("observation_name")|dplyr::starts_with("observation_sum")|dplyr::starts_with("seed_sequence")|dplyr::starts_with("Kingdom")|dplyr::starts_with("Phylum")|dplyr::starts_with("Class")|dplyr::starts_with("Order")|dplyr::starts_with("Family")|dplyr::starts_with("Genus")|dplyr::starts_with("Species")|dplyr::contains("CT_")|dplyr::contains("NC_")|dplyr::starts_with("Genus2"))

dim(at_16S_Controls) #3950 clusters
```

### TCC : Filter abundances based on negative controls
```{r}
at_16S_Controls_Negatives <- at_16S_Controls %>% 
  dplyr::select(contains("Genus2") |contains("_EXT_")|contains("_PCR_") | contains("NC_")| contains("INDEX_"))
dim(at_16S_Controls_Negatives) #54 clusters

# Transform in long format to find the maximum coverage depth of each OTUs across all negative controls (Sort final dataset to sort OTUs in the right order)
at_16S_Controls_Negatives <- at_16S_Controls_Negatives %>% 
 tidyr::pivot_longer(!Genus2, names_to = c("Barcode")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Genus2) %>%
  dplyr::slice(which.max(value)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(factor(Genus2, levels = at_16S$Genus2))  %>%
  print(n = 50)

#Check the taxa that contaminated the control (sorting the more present at the top of the list)
at_16S_Controls_Negatives <- at_16S_Controls_Negatives %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(desc(value))

at_16S_Tccfiltered <- at_16S %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(-contains("_EXT") & -contains("_PCR") & -contains("NC_") & -contains("INDEX") &
    (ends_with("_A")|ends_with("_B")|contains("MOCK")|contains("Undetermined")),
    ~Filter_contaminant(., at_16S_Controls_Negatives$value)))
dim(at_16S_Tccfiltered)
```

### TFA : Filter abundances based on number of sequences on the flow cell
```{r}
Rfa <- 0.0001

at_16S_TccTfafiltered <- at_16S %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(-contains("_EXT") & -contains("_PCR") & -contains("NC_") & -contains("INDEX") &
    (ends_with("_A")|ends_with("_B")|contains("MOCK")|contains("Undetermined")),
    ~Filter_contaminant(., at_16S_Tccfiltered$observation_sum*Rfa)))
dim(at_16S_TccTfafiltered)
```

### Merge PCR replicas
```{r}
# Remove some columns
data_16S <- at_16S_TccTfafiltered %>%
  dplyr::select(!(dplyr::starts_with("observation_sum")|dplyr::starts_with("Kingdom")|dplyr::starts_with("Phylum")|dplyr::starts_with("Class")|dplyr::starts_with("Order")|dplyr::starts_with("Family")|dplyr::starts_with("Genus")|dplyr::starts_with("Genus2")|dplyr::starts_with("Species")))

# Transform from wide to long format
data_16S <- data_16S %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -c(observation_name, seed_sequence), names_to = "Barcode", values_to = "count")
  #tidyr::pivot_longer(!observation_name, names_to = "Barcode", values_to = "count") #table with OTUs (Clusters) in rows and pool of samples they are in + its amount in columns

# Apply the function Remove_last_two_chars in the abundance table (remove -A or -B distinction)
data_16S$Samples <- sapply(data_16S$Barcode, Remove_last_two_chars)

# Compute sum across the replicates
data_16S <- data_16S %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(observation_name, seed_sequence, Samples) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(SumCount = ifelse(sum(count == 0)>=1, 0, round(sum(count)))) %>% 
  dplyr::ungroup()
```

### Merge run replicas (run 1, 2 or 3)
```{r}
# Apply the function Remove_last_two_chars in the abundance table (_rn1, 2 or 3)
data_16S$Samples <- sapply(data_16S$Samples, Remove_last_two_chars_run)

# Compute sum across the replicates
data_16S <- data_16S %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(observation_name, seed_sequence, Samples) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(SumCount = ifelse(sum(SumCount == 0)>=1, 0, round(sum(SumCount)))) %>% 
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Transform from long to wide format
data_16S <- data_16S %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Samples, values_from = SumCount)

# Export
write.table(data_16S, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "1_PrepareData", "16S_TM123_abundance.tsv"), sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE, quote=FALSE)
```

# 3. Fungal community

## 3.1. Abundance table

### Import & Clean Abundance Table
```{r}
ab_ITS <- data.table::fread(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "raw_data", "ITS_TM123-[FROGS_BIOM_to_TSV__abundance.tsv].tsv"),sep="\t",header=TRUE)
dim(ab_ITS)

# Clean taxonomy of abundance table
ab_ITS <- Clean_ab_table(abundance_table = ab_ITS, remove_col = NULL) #Expected 7 pieces. Missing pieces filled with `NA` in 294 rows
```

### Import & Clean Multi-Affiliation Table
```{r}
ma_ITS <- data.table::fread(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "raw_data", "ITS_TM123-[FROGS_BIOM_to_TSV__multi-affiliations.tsv].tsv"),sep="\t",header=TRUE)
dim(ma_ITS)

# Clean taxonomy of multi-affiliation table
taxo_ITS_Multiaffiliation <- Define_multiaffiliation(multiaffiliation_table = ma_ITS, thresh = 0.5)

dim(taxo_ITS_Multiaffiliation)
```

### Compute coverage depth for each type of sample

```{r}
# Subset dataset (filter controls) and transpose it to have sample on rows
abundance_table_ITS <- at_ITS %>%
  dplyr::select(matches("ITS_MS|Kingdom|observation_name")) %>% 
  dplyr::rename_with( ~ gsub("ITS_", "", .x, fixed = TRUE))%>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(!c(observation_name, Kingdom), names_to="ID_pool", values_to = "cov_depth")

# Rename samples without replicate "A" and "B"
abundance_table_ITS <- abundance_table_ITS %>%
  dplyr::mutate(ID_pool=gsub("_A|_B", "", ID_pool))

# Add corresponding samples' info from metadata
abundance_table_ITS <- abundance_table_ITS  %>%
  dplyr::left_join(mt[, c("ID_pool", "FrozenLifeStage", "SampleType", "Infestation")], by= "ID_pool")

abundance_table_ITS$cov_depth <- as.integer(abundance_table_ITS$cov_depth)

# Compute coverage depth for each sample type
sample.size_ITS <- abundance_table_ITS %>%
  dplyr::group_by(SampleType, Infestation, Kingdom) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n_distinct(ID_pool), cov_depth=sum(cov_depth))%>%
  dplyr::mutate(prop_cov_depth = round(cov_depth/sum(cov_depth), 2))

# Export
write.table(sample.size_ITS, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "1_PrepareData", "ITS_TM123_Coverage_depth_per_Sample_Type.csv"), sep=";", row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE, quote=FALSE)

#Plot
# Create a stacked bar plot of kingdom proportions by SampleType
ITS_prop <- ggplot(sample.size_ITS, aes(x = SampleType, y = prop_cov_depth, fill = Kingdom)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") + 
  labs(
    title = "Proportions of Kingdoms by Sample Type - ITS",
    x = "Sample Type",
    y = "Proportion of coverage depth"
  ) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Fungi" = "green3", "Plantae" = "green4", "Chromista" = "green", "no" = "grey" , "Unknown" = "grey")) +  # Example colors, adjust for your kingdoms
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"  )

title_plot <- "ITS_TM123_CovDepth_Proportions.png"
 cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots","1_PrepareData", title_plot),
                 ITS_prop, base_height = 20/cm(1),
                base_width = 25/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
```

```{r}
dim(at_ITS)

at_ITS_Unknown$observation_name # 0 clusters 

# blast_taxonomy : Multi-affiliation in Kingdom rank
at_ITS_Multiaffiliation <- at_ITS[at_ITS$Kingdom == "Multi-affiliation",]
at_ITS_Multiaffiliation$observation_name # no cluster

# blast_taxonomy : Bacteria in Kingdom rank
at_ITS_Bacteria <-  at_ITS[at_ITS$Kingdom == "Bacteria",]
at_ITS_Bacteria$observation_name # no cluster

# blast_taxonomy : Plantae in Kingdom rank
at_ITS_Plantae <-  at_ITS[at_ITS$Kingdom =="Plantae_Chl" | at_ITS$Kingdom =="Plantae" |	at_ITS$Kingdom =="Plantae_Mit",]
at_ITS_Plantae$observation_name # no cluster

# Delete these clusters
at_ITS <- at_ITS  %>%
  dplyr::slice(which(is.na(match(Kingdom, c("Plantae", "Plantae_Chl", "Plantae_Mit", "Bacteria"))))) #, "Multi-affiliation", "Unknown"

dim(at_ITS)
```

### Replace "Multi-affiliation", "unidentified", "unknown species", "unknown genus", "unknown family", "unknown" by "Unknown" in the taxonomy
```{r}
replace_names <- c("Multi-affiliation", "unidentified", "unknown species", "unknown genus", "unknown family", "unknown")

at_ITS <- at_ITS %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Kingdom = ifelse(Kingdom %in% replace_names, "Unknown", Kingdom),
         Phylum = ifelse(Phylum %in% replace_names, "Unknown", Phylum),
         Class = ifelse(Class %in% replace_names, "Unknown", Class),
         Order = ifelse(Order %in% replace_names, "Unknown", Order),
         Family = ifelse(Family %in% replace_names, "Unknown", Family),
         Genus = ifelse(Genus %in% replace_names, "Unknown", Genus),
         Species = ifelse(Species %in% replace_names, "Unknown", Species))

# Create a Genus_2 column with the Genus and row number
at_ITS$Genus2 <- paste0(at_ITS$Genus, rownames(at_ITS))
```

### Filter abundance table
```{r}
# Select columns
at_ITS <- at_ITS %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::starts_with("observation_name")|dplyr::starts_with("observation_sum")|dplyr::starts_with("seed_sequence")|dplyr::starts_with("Kingdom")|dplyr::starts_with("Phylum")|dplyr::starts_with("Class")|dplyr::starts_with("Order")|dplyr::starts_with("Family")|dplyr::starts_with("Genus")|dplyr::starts_with("Species")|dplyr::starts_with("ITS_")|dplyr::starts_with("16S_")|dplyr::starts_with("NC_")|dplyr::starts_with("Undetermined"))

# Controls
at_ITS_Controls <- at_ITS %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::starts_with("observation_name")|dplyr::starts_with("observation_sum")|dplyr::starts_with("seed_sequence")|dplyr::starts_with("Kingdom")|dplyr::starts_with("Phylum")|dplyr::starts_with("Class")|dplyr::starts_with("Order")|dplyr::starts_with("Family")|dplyr::starts_with("Genus")|dplyr::starts_with("Species")|dplyr::contains("CT_")|dplyr::contains("NC_")|dplyr::starts_with("Genus2"))

dim(at_ITS_Controls)
```

### TCC : Filter abundances based on negative controls

```{r}
at_ITS_Controls_Negatives <- at_ITS_Controls %>% 
  dplyr::select(contains("Genus2") |contains("_EXT_")|contains("_PCR_") | contains("NC_")| contains("INDEX_"))
dim(at_ITS_Controls_Negatives)

# Transform in long format to find the maximum coverage depth of each OTUs across all negative controls (Sort final dataset so that OTUs are in the right order)
at_ITS_Controls_Negatives <- at_ITS_Controls_Negatives %>% 
 tidyr::pivot_longer(!Genus2, names_to = c("Barcode")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Genus2) %>%
  dplyr::slice(which.max(value)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(factor(Genus2, levels = at_ITS$Genus2))  %>%
  print(n = 30)
## Check the taxa that contaminated the control
dplyr::arrange(at_ITS_Controls_Negatives, desc(value))

at_ITS_Tccfiltered <- at_ITS %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(
    -contains("_EXT") & -contains("_PCR") & -contains("NC_") & -contains("INDEX") &
    (ends_with("_A")|ends_with("_B")|contains("MOCK")|contains("Undetermined")),
    ~Filter_contaminant(., at_ITS_Controls_Negatives$value)))
```

### TFA : Filter abundances based on number of sequences on the flow cell
```{r}
Rfa <- 0.0001

at_ITS_TccTfafiltered <- at_ITS %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(
    -contains("_EXT") & -contains("_PCR") & -contains("NC_") & -contains("INDEX") &
    (ends_with("_A")|ends_with("_B")|contains("MOCK")|contains("Undetermined")),
    ~Filter_contaminant(., at_ITS_Tccfiltered$observation_sum*Rfa)))
```

### Merge PCR replicas
```{r}
# Remove some columns
data_ITS <- at_ITS_TccTfafiltered %>%
  dplyr::select(!(dplyr::starts_with("observation_sum")|dplyr::starts_with("Kingdom")|dplyr::starts_with("Phylum")|dplyr::starts_with("Class")|dplyr::starts_with("Order")|dplyr::starts_with("Family")|dplyr::starts_with("Genus")|dplyr::starts_with("Genus2")|dplyr::starts_with("Species")))

# Transform from wide to long format
data_ITS <- data_ITS %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -c(observation_name, seed_sequence), names_to = "Barcode", values_to = "count")
 # tidyr::pivot_longer(!observation_name, names_to = "Barcode", values_to = "count")

# Apply the function Remove_last_two_chars in the abundance table (_A or _B)
data_ITS$Samples <- sapply(data_ITS$Barcode, Remove_last_two_chars)

# Compute sum across the replicates
data_ITS <- data_ITS %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(observation_name, seed_sequence, Samples) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(SumCount = ifelse(sum(count == 0)>=1, 0, round(sum(count)))) %>% 
  dplyr::ungroup()
```

### Merge run replicas (1, 2, or 3)
```{r}
# Apply the function Remove_last_two_chars in the abundance table (_rn1, 2 or 3)
data_ITS$Samples <- sapply(data_ITS$Samples, Remove_last_two_chars_run)

# Compute sum across the replicates
data_ITS <- data_ITS %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(observation_name, seed_sequence, Samples) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(SumCount = ifelse(sum(SumCount == 0)>=1, 0, round(sum(SumCount)))) %>% 
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Transform from long to wide format
data_ITS <- data_ITS %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Samples, values_from = SumCount)

# Export
write.table(data_ITS, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "1_PrepareData", "ITS_TM123_abundance.tsv"), sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE, quote=FALSE)
```
